text: So that many of the popular pleaders used to make it a jest against him; and Pytheas once, scoffing at him, said that his arguments smelt of the lamp. To which Demosthenes gave the sharp answer, "It is true, indeed, Pytheas, that your lamp and mine are not conscious of the same things."
author: Plutarch
speaker: Demosthenes
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
